title: Containers: inside the platform box of diagram 01; the deployable roles, the stores and the trust boundaries, and who calls whom (key management is on the deployment diagram)
arrows: synchronous calls; protocol and authentication in brackets

nodes.label: Operators
nodes.desc: Operator pages of the same workspace

nodes.label: Browser workspace
nodes.tech: TypeScript, Forma 3.0.0 core: native islands; the canvas island and the renderer library
nodes.desc: Adopts server-rendered pages; the canvas, forms and the composer chat

nodes.label: Edge
nodes.tech: CloudFront, Application Load Balancer, AWS WAF
nodes.desc: Terminates TLS, routes by host, rate-limits, caches only hash-named assets

nodes.label: Workspace server
nodes.tech: Rust, axum, forma-server 3.0.0; new in this release
nodes.desc: Renders pages and the canvas from typed props; the one authorization point; navigation, saved work, drafts, previews, the JSON API

nodes.label: Control plane
nodes.desc: Admits definitions, applies the organization's publication policy, records publications and audit; the only writer of publications

nodes.label: Data service
nodes.tech: Rust; DuckDB over Parquet; PostgreSQL commands
nodes.desc: Runs typed queries with receipts over source revisions; commits record commands with idempotency and compare-and-set

nodes.label: Composer and import workers
nodes.tech: Rust jobs; parsers in an isolated process with no network and no keys
nodes.desc: Generation, import parsing to Parquet, retrieval index building, explanations

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.tech: RDS Multi-AZ; one schema, organization id in every key, row-level security
nodes.desc: Apps, definitions, publications, policy, saved work, records, jobs, audit, idempotency outcomes

nodes.label: Object storage
nodes.tech: S3, per-organization prefixes, encrypted under the organization's KMS data key
nodes.desc: Originals, Parquet revisions, exports, retrieval index files, retained assets; deletion by crypto-shredding

nodes.label: fAuth
nodes.desc: Hosted sign-in; EdDSA tokens; key set at /auth/jwks

nodes.label: Model provider
nodes.desc: Sees schemas, catalog metadata and synthetic rows by default

edges.label: requests pages and API calls [HTTPS, session cookie]
admits, publishes, sets policy, writes governance audit [HTTP, service token]
runs queries, submits commands [HTTP, service token]
reads and writes apps, drafts, saved work, personal state, jobs [TLS, role workspace]
redirects sign-in, exchanges the code, fetches the key set [HTTPS]
writes publications, policy, audit [TLS, role control]
writes records, receipts, outcomes [TLS, role data]
claim jobs, write results [TLS, role worker]
read originals, write Parquet and index files [HTTPS, SigV4]
send schemas and synthetic rows, receive proposals [HTTPS, API key]
